narrative: On the bookwheel. A printed slip on the tiring-house table, the one Margery has already spoken from. No day is on it. He does not take it away, and he does not turn it over.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the charge and left the paper where it was.

entities.name: the Guildhall trial
entities.context: Shown on pamphlet in Five, and no day
